statusCode.description_en:
If the request to the target site succeeds, the HTTP status code of the target URL is returned.

If the request to the target site fails, a custom error code is returned:

    2.1 4030: The target site has security restrictions, such as robots.txt or security policies.
    
    2.2 4080: The request timed out.
    
    2.3 4290: The rate limiting policy of the site was triggered.
    
    2.4 5010: An unknown exception occurred
statusCode.description_zh:
若目标站点请求成功，返回目标 url 的 HttpCode。

若目标站点请求失败，返回 IQS 定制错误码：

    2.1 4030：目标站点安全限制（robots.txt、安全策略等）
    
    2.2 4080：请求超时
    
    2.3 4290：触发站点限流策略
    
    2.4 5010：未知异常

description_en: Quickly fetches HTML and parses static web page content
description_zh: 快速获取 HTML 并解析静态网页内容
kebab_example: aliyun iqs read-page-basic --url 'https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2837301.html0spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2837261.d_0_0_0.59ed3e95CppOt2_scm=20140722.H_2837301._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1' --timeout 60000 --page-timeout 10000 --formats html --location example-string --max-age 1296000 --readability '{"excludeAllLinks":false,"readabilityMode":"none","excludedTags":["form"],"excludeAllImages":false}' --api-version 2024-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReadPageBasic

parameters.help_en:
The format of the parsing result.
rawHtml: the HTML of the target website.
html: the page content processed based on readabilityMode.
markdown: the Markdown content converted from HTML.
text: the text content extracted from HTML
parameters.help_zh:
解析结果格式
rawHtml：目标站点的 html
html: 根据 readabilityMode 处理后的页面内容
markdown：根据 html 转换成的 markdown 内容
text：html 中的文本内容
parameters.name: formats

parameters.help_en: You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: location

parameters.help_en:
The maximum cache validity period. Unit: seconds. Default value: 1296000.

If the cache duration is less than the value of maxAge, cached content is returned.

If the value of maxAge is 0, caching is not used
parameters.help_zh:
最大缓存时间，单位（秒），默认值：1296000。

若缓存时间小于 maxAge，则返回缓存内容；

若 maxAge 等于 0，则不使用缓存
parameters.name: max_age

parameters.help_en:
The URL read timeout period. The value of pageTimeout must be less than the value of timeout.

Default value: 10000
parameters.help_zh:
url 读取超时时间，pageTimeout 应小于 timeout 时长

默认值：10000
parameters.name: page_timeout

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to exclude all images.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否剔除所有图片

默认值：false
fields.name: exclude_all_images

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to exclude all links.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否剔除所有链接

默认值：false
fields.name: exclude_all_links

fields.help_en:
Valid values:
none: does not remove any information. Default value: none.

normal: removes irrelevant information from the target page, such as headers, footers, and navigation elements, based on a proprietary algorithm.

article: extracts the main body content of the website based on a proprietary algorithm. This mode is suitable for blogs and news websites, but not for directory or navigation pages
fields.help_zh:
none：不删除信息，默认为 none

normal: 基于自研算法，剔除目标页面无关信息（页头/页脚，导航等）

article: 基于自研算法，获取站点主要正文内容(适用于博客、新闻站点，不适用于目录页、导航页)
fields.name: readability_mode

parameters.help_en: The readability configuration for the parsing result
parameters.name: readability

parameters.help_en:
The end-to-end processing timeout period. Unit: ms.

Valid values: [0, 180000].

Default value: 60000
parameters.help_zh:
全链路处理超时时间，单位：ms

可选值：[0, 180000]

默认值：60000
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The target URL to parse. The value must start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 解析的目标地址，必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
